intended_object: The canonical map α → FreeMonoid α. It sends a generator x to the word of length one, [x]. Its additive version is the corresponding map into the free additive monoid. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: Mathlib models the free monoid on α as lists over α. The definition sends x to `ofList [x]`, the one-letter word, which is the textbook inclusion of the generators. It works for any type α, so it is already at full generality. This is Mathlib's own canonical definition of the map, and I know of no other declaration that defines it.
